description: Calculate the d-band center of the W-terminated hexagonal WC(001) basal surface from projected density of states.
user_prompt: Calculate the d-band center of tungsten carbide on its WC(001) basal surface (hexagonal structure, P-6m2), using the tungsten-terminated surface. Extract the d-band center (in eV relative to the Fermi level) from the surface W atoms' d-orbital projected DOS and report the final value.

references: Wang, Li, Wang, Dai, Lei, Yang, Zhang, Lei, Leung, and Hou, Nano Energy 74, 104850 (2020).
Koverga, Florez, Dorkis, and Rodriguez, J. Phys. Chem. C 123, 8871-8883 (2019).
method.modeling: Use the W-terminated hexagonal WC(001) basal surface and project the DOS on top-layer surface W atoms only.
method.rationale: Wang et al. report the pristine WC surface W d-band center as -1.08 eV for WC(001), with Mo-WC shifted to -1.22 eV. The scored value is for the W-terminated basal surface; C-terminated slabs or subsurface-W projections are different quantities. The 0.4 eV absolute tolerance covers DMol3-vs-PAW projection differences, the paper's unspecified full-vs-occupied integration convention, and the termination sensitivity of this polar surface.
